title: Monash Graduate Scholarship (MGS)
about: Monash University's Round 1 graduate research scholarship round for international applicants, including the Monash Graduate Scholarship, closes 28 February 2027, brought forward from 31 March. Applicants apply with their research degree application.
requirements: Scholarship applications are submitted with the course application; eligible applicants are considered for all available graduate research scholarships
Round dates apply to Australian campuses only

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Doctoral / research master's" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."
"Open across disciplines (graduate research)" → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
